main_text.p: mentorum certant. {6}Protestantes ab auctoribus suis nomina induere; atq; alios dici Lutheranos; alios Calvinianos; alios Zvinglianos : At Romanos pontificios nunquam ab uno aliquo certo homine esse vocatos; Illud autem esse proprium haereticorum et schismaticorum; idq; constare ex 1. Cor.3. resp. Equidem istiusmodi elogiis & titulis ornantur à pontificiis vel Jesuiticis doctoribus, eorumque asseclis; at non ex mente Lutheri, vel Calvini, vel Zvinglii, vel ullius sani. neque enim in ullius hominis, sed in Christi nomen baptizati sumus, neque etiam in ullius hominis, licet praestantissimi, doctissimi, verba juramus, sed ad amussim s. literarum omne fidei negocium institui atque examinari petimus, urgemus. Id quod ipse Bellarminus ipse profitetur de verbo Dei lib. 3. cap.3. Protestantes, inquit, tenent, Spiritum non esse alligatum ullis episcopis, aut ulli hominum generi: & Johannes Calvinus omnium hominum, atque adeo ipsorum cō-

page.notes: Reference mark "6" stands in the text before "Protestantes"; no matching note is printed on this page. The text block is one column with no marginal notes. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page's gutter and is not transcribed. Faint stains lie over the lower lines but the text is legible. The word "cō-" is a line-end hyphen; the catchword "ciliorum" completes it. Long s is written as plain s throughout, as instructed.
